gloss: to search for; to rummage; to hunt for

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {漁|あさ}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to search for; to rummage through
definitions.explanation: To search through things looking for something specific, often in a messy or thorough way.
When animals or people search for food.

examples.japanese: ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{漁|あさ}る。
examples.english: To search the internet for information.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引|ひ}き{出|だ}し→引き出し：01498_hikidashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{漁|あさ}った。
⟦{古本屋|ふるほんや}→古本屋：16329_furuhonya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{珍|めずら}しい→珍しい：01200_mezurashii⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{漁|あさ}った。

examples.english: A bear was rummaging through the garbage.

examples.english: Foraging for shellfish on the beach at low tide was one of the joys of my childhood.

notes:
{漁|あさ}る is a transitive verb (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧). There is no intransitive pair.

ASPECT (ている):
{漁|あさ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates an ongoing action of searching or rummaging.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [place]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{漁|あさ}る - to rummage through [place]
- ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{漁|あさ}る - to hunt for information
- ⟦{餌|えさ}→餌：01886_esa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{漁|あさ}る - to forage for food
- ⟦{女|おんな}→女：00559_onna⟧/⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{漁|あさ}る - to pursue women/men (negative nuance)

USAGE:
This verb often implies a somewhat indiscriminate or thorough search, sometimes with a slightly negative connotation of being greedy or indiscriminate.

WRITING:
The kanji {漁|あさ} is the same as in ⟦{漁業|ぎょぎょう}→漁業：20496_gyogyou⟧ (fishing industry), reflecting the original meaning of fishing/foraging.
